ky-jefferson-2026-district-judge-div6-la.name: Lisa L. Langford
ky-jefferson-2026-district-judge-div6-la.bio: District Court Judge in Jefferson County; previously a prosecutor with the Jefferson County Attorney's Office and an attorney with the City of Louisville Law Department.

ky-jefferson-2026-district-judge-div6-go.name: Teddy B. Gordon
ky-jefferson-2026-district-judge-div6-go.bio: Louisville attorney who has practiced law for 54 years, with work focused on civil rights, education law, and children with special needs.

positions.stance: Emphasizes "equal justice, fairness, and respect for the law across the matters handled in District Court."
Believes "violent offenses should carry meaningful consequences" and that the court must take seriously the safety of the community.
For people struggling with alcohol or drug addiction, supports "treatment and assistance when appropriate rather than relying on incarceration alone."

ky-jefferson-2026-district-judge-div8-fa.name: Karen Faulkner
ky-jefferson-2026-district-judge-div8-fa.bio: Jefferson County District Court Judge since 2022; former private-practice attorney and Louisville Metro public defender.

or-multnomah-2026-circuit-pos2-sykes-dia.name: Diane S Sykes
or-multnomah-2026-circuit-pos2-sykes-dia.bio: Attorney who has worked as a public defender, a Legal Aid lawyer, and in private practice.

or-multnomah-2026-circuit-pos2-rowan-lau.name: Laura Maurer Rowan
or-multnomah-2026-circuit-pos2-rowan-lau.bio: Former prosecutor, deputy city attorney, and senior assistant attorney general in Oregon.

or-multnomah-2026-circuit-pos14-savage-e.name: Elizabeth Savage
or-multnomah-2026-circuit-pos14-savage-e.bio: Family law attorney, former teacher, and judge pro tem.

or-multnomah-2026-circuit-pos14-hagedorn.name: Joseph Hagedorn
or-multnomah-2026-circuit-pos14-hagedorn.bio: Pro tem judge and attorney whose career has focused on representing people without the means to defend themselves.

nv-clark-2026-dc05-barisich-veronica.name: Veronica Barisich
nv-clark-2026-dc05-barisich-veronica.bio: Presiding Judge of Department 5 of the Eighth Judicial District Court since January 2021.

positions.stance: "Every party deserves to be heard, and every decision should be based upon the law and the evidence."
"Litigants, attorneys, witnesses, jurors and members of the public deserve to be treated with professionalism and dignity."
Justice requires careful consideration, but "courts must also recognize the value of people's time and resources."
"Judges must make decisions based upon the Constitution, Nevada law and the facts before them" and never politics or outside pressure.

nv-clark-2026-dc05-hibbetts-tracy.name: Tracy Hibbetts
nv-clark-2026-dc05-hibbetts-tracy.bio: Chief Deputy District Attorney in Clark County and former Chief Deputy Public Defender.

nv-clark-2026-dc08-beaumont-austin.name: Austin Beaumont
nv-clark-2026-dc08-beaumont-austin.bio: Attorney and former judicial law clerk for two Eighth Judicial District Court judges.

nv-clark-2026-dc08-peterson-jessica.name: Jessica K. Peterson
nv-clark-2026-dc08-peterson-jessica.bio: District court judge who has presided over civil, criminal, and probate cases.
